purpose: Provides a three-layer framework that integrates conflicting design theories, explaining how to apply cognitive constraints, structural tools, and a chosen aesthetic direction in order.
summary: Three-layer model applied from the bottom up
Layer 1 cognitive constraints: Fitts, Hick, Miller, contrast ratio
Layer 2 structural tools: modular scale, color harmony, 60-30-10, 8pt grid
Composition principles and curvature psychology with radius guidance
Layer 3 aesthetic directions: Rams, Norman, Tufte, wabi-sabi
Direction selection guide by app character
tasks: Choosing a design direction for an app
Deriving typography, color, and spacing values with rationale
title: デザイン哲学 — 美しいデザインの統合的原理
